Read WorldClim 2.1 CMIP6 future climate for a region

Source: R/worldclim.R
worldclim_future_region.Rd

Reads the part of a WorldClim 2.1 downscaled CMIP6 projection (monthly minimum or maximum temperature, or precipitation, at 30 arc-seconds) that covers a region, without downloading the global file (about 5 GB per variable, model, scenario and period). Only the bytes of the region are read with GDAL /vsicurl/, and the result is cached in path.

Usage

worldclim_future_region(
  var = c("tmin", "tmax", "prec"),
  region,
  gcm,
  ssp = c("245", "126", "370", "585"),
  period = c("2041-2060", "2021-2040", "2061-2080", "2081-2100"),
  path,
  mask = TRUE,
  touches = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

var

"tmin", "tmax" or "prec".

region

A SpatExtent, a numeric vector c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) in longitude/latitude, or a SpatVector (any CRS; polygons can be used as a mask).

gcm

Global climate model, for example "MPI-ESM1-2-HR". See worldclim_cmip6_gcms for the models listed by WorldClim.

ssp

Shared socio-economic pathway: "126", "245", "370" or "585".

period

"2021-2040", "2041-2060", "2061-2080" or "2081-2100".

path

Cache directory.

mask

If TRUE and region is a polygon SpatVector, mask cells outside the polygons.

touches

Passed to terra::mask(): keep cells touched by the polygon boundary.

overwrite

Ignore and replace a cached file.

Value

A SpatRaster in EPSG:4326 at 30 arc-seconds with 12 layers m01 to m12. Attribute "source" gives the remote file read.

Details

WorldClim derives the future surfaces from each global climate model (GCM) by adding the model's change to the WorldClim 2.1 baseline (1970-2000) and applying a bias correction. Differences between a future layer and worldclim_region() are therefore the projected change of that model. Single models can be far from the multi-model consensus: use several GCMs and report their spread.

Not every model provides every scenario; a missing combination gives an informative error.

References

Fick, S. E., & Hijmans, R. J. (2017). WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology, 37(12), 4302-4315. doi:10.1002/joc.5086

Eyring, V., et al. (2016). Overview of the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) experimental design and organization. Geoscientific Model Development, 9(5), 1937-1958. doi:10.5194/gmd-9-1937-2016

See also

worldclim_region() for the 1970-2000 baseline.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
prov <- cauquenes_boundary("provincia")
now <- worldclim_region("tmin", prov, path = tempdir())
fut <- worldclim_future_region("tmin", prov, gcm = "MPI-ESM1-2-HR",
                               ssp = "245", period = "2041-2060",
                               path = tempdir())
fut - now   # projected change of this model, degrees C
} # }
